round1_result: sg2 kind, 2000 updates at the nominal 1.296x scale, five folds: val-5 F1 0.609-0.671 (mean 0.642, same as the 20-image detectors), coverage hull median 0.10-0.12 of the frame (one cluster, like the 20-image detectors), single hex6 blend -0.056 pp HEX on A, 10-detector ensemble on B -0.0286 (unchanged). Pre-training loss plateaued at 0.43 (fine-tune reaches 0.30).

round2_variants.transfer-check: val-5 F1 of the pre-trained head WITHOUT the 20-image fine-tune, thresholds 0.2/0.35/0.5: measures whether srep supervision transfers at all
round2_variants.long: 6000 pre-training updates at the nominal scale (GPU 2)
round2_variants.g1a_2000: G1a selection re-run on fold 4 with 2000 scoring rows (standard error of r ~0.02 instead of ~0.045)

judging: as round 1 (val-5 F1, coverage, LOFO hex6 blend on B alone and in the 9-set); success per PI rule; falsification: if the transfer-check F1 is < 0.3 at every threshold, srep points do not transfer across device/scale and the external route is closed after these variants.
